title: Witnessing
definition: Witnessing is bearing testimony to Jesus Christ through words, conduct, and faithful presence before others.
summary: Witnessing points others to Christ through truthful words and a faithful life.
christFocus: Jesus sends His people as witnesses to His death, resurrection, lordship, and saving grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Witnessing is the calling to bear testimony to Christ. It includes speaking the Gospel, sharing personal testimony of grace, living visibly as a follower of Jesus, and pointing others toward truth.

A witness does not invent the message. The witness testifies to what God has revealed and what Christ has done. The Holy Spirit empowers this witness.

Witnessing happens in ordinary relationships, conversations, suffering, service, and acts of love. Believers are called to be ready, gentle, truthful, and courageous.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers think witnessing is only for gifted speakers or formal evangelists. Witnessing matters because every Christian can testify to Christ in everyday life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God for courage and clarity. Be prepared to explain the hope you have in Christ, and let your conduct support rather than contradict your witness.
